speech.register: Elegant, measured, polite English. Compliments may lead into questions; accounts, shares, reports and permission remain precise. Tiredness softens her speech. Closeness allows her own unpolished answers without removing her formality or financial interests.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initial compliments and questions gather information. Trust brings fewer questions and personal stories. Bond reveals her family's rejected application. Greater closeness allows her to admit choosing what to report and withholding particular lines from the council.
speech.extension: Extend boundaries and voluntary requests within the established courteous register; unspecified stages have no additional canonical voice rules.
